info.title: GoCommerce Electronics Store API
info.description: Backend MVP: accounts, electronics catalog, cart, COD orders. No refresh token, online payments, email, or frontend yet.

servers.description: Proposed production domain; deployment is a separate step

put.summary: Replace product using optimistic version check
put.description: version must match the most recently read product; stale writes return 409. Checkout and cancellation also increment version.

delete.summary: Deactivate product without deleting order history

200.description: Idempotent replay of an existing order; Idempotency-Replayed: true

post.description: Price is read from PostgreSQL. Cart and stock changes are atomic. Reusing the key with identical shipping input returns the original order even if the cart has since changed; a key identifies exactly one checkout. Different input with the same key returns 409.

get.summary: Get own order and price snapshots

post.summary: Cancel a placed order and restore stock once

AdminKey.name: X-API-Key
AdminKey.description: Bootstrap admin credential. Server-side/CLI only; never include in frontend code.
